# Feature: Registration Route with Sign Up / Sign In

## Overview
Add a dedicated registration route where signing up or signing in happens on a single page with a mode toggle. The UI reuses the current Light/Dark theme system (ThemeContext + CSS variables) and existing form/button styles. UI-first by default: sign-up integrates with the real `POST /api/users/` endpoint, while sign-in is simulated client-side (backend has no login/token endpoint — auth remains bypassed per blueprint constraints) with a `localStorage` mock session.

## User Stories
- As a visitor, I want to open a registration page so I can create an account or sign in to an existing one.
- As a visitor, I want to toggle between Sign Up and Sign In on the same page so I do not need two separate URLs.
- As a visitor, I want the auth page to match the board's Light/Dark theme so the product feels cohesive.
- As an Admin user, I want newly registered users to appear in the backend user list so they can later be selected as task assignees.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components
- `client/src/pages/AuthPage.jsx` (route path `/register`) — page shell: centered card layout (`.auth-page`, `.auth-card` in `index.css`), title/subtitle, mode toggle (two `type="button"` tabs with `aria-pressed`), conditional fields, submit + error/success messaging. Export as `AuthPage` to keep naming flexible; route stays `/register` per request.
- `client/src/components/AuthForm.jsx` — reusable presentational form used by `AuthPage`: `username`, `password`, `confirmPassword` (sign-up only), show/hide password toggle, client validation messages, `isSubmitting` disabled state. Follows `CreateProjectForm` + `TaskModal` input patterns (label `htmlFor`/`id`, no `autoFocus` per Sprint 1.3 a11y policy).
- `client/src/pages/AuthPage.test.jsx` + `client/src/components/AuthForm.test.jsx` (or single page-level test) — Vitest coverage: renders sign-in by default, toggles to sign-up, validates empty/short inputs, mocks sign-up success and sign-in success/failure.
- `client/src/App.jsx` — add `<Route path="/register"><AuthPage /></Route>` inside existing `<Switch>`.
- `client/src/components/Navbar.jsx` — add Sign in link (`LogIn` icon from `lucide-react`, `Link href="/register"`); when a mock session exists, show username badge + Sign out button instead (reads `getSessionUser()`).
- `client/src/index.css` — reuse theme tokens and button/input styles; add only `.auth-page`, `.auth-card`, `.auth-tabs`, `.auth-error` (role="alert"), `.auth-success` (role="status").

### Data Model (Mock)
Backend user schema (existing, `backend/tasks/views.py:UserViewSet`, `router.register(r"users", ...)` in `backend/tasks/urls.py`):
```python
# id: int (PK), username: str (unique, required), password: write-only at creation
```

Client session mock persisted in `localStorage`:
```js
// key
"task-tracker:auth-user" // JSON: { "id": 1, "username": "maya" } | null

// mock user store for UI-first sign-in (before real login endpoint exists)
const MOCK_USERS = [
  { id: 1, username: "Admin" },
  { id: 2, username: "maya" },
]
```

Sample payloads:
```js
// Sign up request → POST /api/users/
{ "username": "maya", "password": "s3cret-pass" }
// Sign up response (password never returned)
{ "id": 2, "username": "maya" }
// Sign in (simulated): lookup by username in MOCK_USERS + GET /api/users/ result, verify non-empty password client-side only
```

### Simulated Backend
- Sign Up (real where available): new `userApi.createUser({ username, password })` in `client/src/services/api.js` → `apiRequest("/users/", { method: "POST", body })`. On success, persist `{ id, username }` via `setSessionUser()` and show success message. On 400 (duplicate username), surface backend `detail`/`username` error in `role="alert"`. Offline/network failure follows `isNetworkError` pattern — surface retryable error, do not queue auth (unlike tasks/projects).
- Sign In (simulated): `authService.signIn({ username, password })` in new `client/src/services/authService.js` — tries `userApi.getUsers()` to find username match (falls back to `MOCK_USERS` on failure for UI-first demo); any non-empty password accepted; persists session to `localStorage`; returns `{ id, username }`. Wrong/unknown user → "Invalid username or password." error. No token handling — auth stays bypassed per blueprint.
- `authService.signOut()` clears the session key; `authService.getSessionUser()` reads it (used by Navbar badge).

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Extend `client/src/services/api.js`: add `userApi.createUser({ username, password })` → `POST /users/`; keep existing `getUsers()`. No backend changes (endpoint already exists).
2. Create `client/src/services/authService.js`: `SESSION_KEY = "task-tracker:auth-user"`, exports `getSessionUser()`, `setSessionUser(user)`, `signOut()`, `signIn({ username, password })` (simulated as above). Pure functions + `localStorage` for testability.
3. Create `client/src/components/AuthForm.jsx`: props `{ mode: "signin" | "signup", onSubmit, isSubmitting, serverError }`; controlled inputs; client validation (username ≥ 3 chars, password ≥ 4 chars for sign-in / ≥ 8 for sign-up, confirm match on sign-up); show/hide password button (`type="button"`, `aria-label`); inline field errors + `serverError` in `role="alert"`.
4. Create `client/src/pages/AuthPage.jsx`: `mode` state default `"signin"`; tab toggle resets errors; `handleSubmit` delegates to `userApi.createUser` (signup) or `authService.signIn` (signin); success → `role="status"` message + optional redirect to `/` via wouter `useLocation`; styled card centered, works under both `data-theme="light"` and `data-theme="dark"` with no extra theme code.
5. Wire route in `client/src/App.jsx`: import `AuthPage`, add `<Route path="/register"><AuthPage /></Route>`.
6. Update `client/src/components/Navbar.jsx`: import `LogIn`/`LogOut`, `getSessionUser`/`signOut`; render Sign in link or `{username}` + Sign out; sign-out clears session and stays on current route.
7. Add minimal CSS + tests: new classes in `index.css` using existing tokens (no new palette); `AuthPage.test.jsx` mocks `userApi`/`authService`; run `pnpm test:run` and `pnpm check`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `/register` route renders an auth page in the current Light/Dark theme with Sign In / Sign Up toggle on one page.
- [ ] Sign Up validates inputs, calls `POST /api/users/`, persists `{ id, username }` session on success, and surfaces duplicate-user backend errors accessibly.
- [ ] Sign In validates inputs, resolves against user list (simulated, no token), persists session on success, and shows invalid-credentials error otherwise.
- [ ] Navbar shows Sign in link when logged out and username + Sign out when logged in; theme toggle unaffected.
- [ ] No third-party auth/drag libraries; no user-management controls added to the board itself (assignee dropdown unchanged).
- [ ] `pnpm test:run` and `pnpm check` pass for new/changed files.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: None — this feature is independent within this sprint (new `AuthPage`/`AuthForm`/`authService` + `userApi.createUser`; does not depend on the settings route).
- **External**: None. Uses existing `wouter`, `lucide-react`, `apiClient.apiRequest`, Vitest + React Testing Library.
